basic_info.description: 1826 Eddy Street #101 is a modern urban oasis in the heart of San Francisco. Discover the perfect blend of contemporary design and unbeatable location in this stunning 2bd, 2bth, open floorplan condo. This 2-story home offers a unique combination of style, comfort, and convenience. The bright & airy layout with soaring ceilings & an abundance of natural light create an inviting, open atmosphere. The lofted, upper-level, primary suite offers privacy while maintaining a modern feel. A private patio off the living room extends your living space and is perfect for morning coffee or evening relaxation. Built in 2000, the building offers a contemporary design aesthetic with all the amenities you need, including new floors, in-unit washer/dryer, and a deeded storage unit. Enjoy the rare luxury of a 2-car garage with independent parking. A communal outdoor space provides a green retreat. With a walk Score of 97, this home is steps away from some of the city's most vibrant neighborhoods, including NoPa, Alamo Square, Lower Pac Heights, Anza Vista, and Western Addition. Take a quick stroll to the Divisadero street corridor, iconic Alamo Square Park, Japantown, or Fillmore Street shops and restaurants and discover all that this home has to offer locally as well!
